senses.gloss: m. (פְּרַת) = h. פָּרָשָׁה, branching off, division, esp. פ׳ דכרסא (or sub. כרסא) partition of the belly, navel.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 40:16">Targ. Job XL, 16</cite> <he>פ׳ דכ׳</he> ed. Lag. (oth. ed. <he>פרת דכ׳</he>, read: <he>פְּרַת כ׳</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 7:3">Targ. Cant. VII, 3</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 11:31">Targ. Y. Num. XI, 31</cite>.—Pl. constr. <he>פְּרָתֵי</he>.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 3:9">Targ. Job III, 9</cite> (<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 3:10">10</cite>) ed. Lag. a. oth. (Ms. <he>פְּרָתִי</he>), v. <cite ref="Q00032"><he>פָּאתָא</he> II</cite>.
